items.titleZh: 美国电视网络因特朗普的媒体禁令暂停白宫现场报道
items.summaryZh: 由于白宫禁止多家媒体进入现场，美国主要电视新闻机构决定暂停对特朗普的视频报道。受限媒体已就此提起诉讼，指控政府侵犯了宪法第一修正案赋予的权利。
items.whyImportant: 此事件凸显了美国政府与主流媒体之间日益紧张的关系及新闻自由面临的挑战。

items.title: How Hong Kong can keep the talking going when US-China officials don’t
items.summary: When Tung Chee-hwa died, the obituaries predictably described a Hong Kong shipping mogul who became the city’s first postcolonial chief executive. How his government navigated the Asian financial crisis and severe acute respiratory syndrome (Sars) epidemic and its retreat from Article 23 were highlighted. There was less attention paid to the political hybrid he embodied. Tung sat as vice-chairman of China’s top political advisory body, the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference,...
items.titleZh: 当美中官员停止对话时，香港如何维持沟通渠道
items.summaryZh: 文章回顾了董建华的政治生涯，探讨了香港在美中关系紧张背景下作为沟通桥梁的潜在作用。分析了香港如何利用其独特的政治地位在复杂的地缘政治中发挥作用。
items.whyImportant: 探讨了香港在美中外交僵局中作为非官方沟通渠道的特殊价值。
